articles.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
articles.summary: The U.S. VC firm still has more than 55% of its previous $650 million India fund available for deployment.

articles.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
articles.summary: OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems.

articles.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
articles.summary: Google also shared numbers of how people are actually using the chatbot, with 63% of Gemini users talking directly to the assistant using the voice feature. Plus, Gemini now generates more than 150 million images every day, according to Google.

articles.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
articles.summary: One of OpenAI's longest-serving executives is headed out the door, although the longtime COO told staff that he was "excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."

articles.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
articles.summary: River AI, a startup founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a fascinating vision for personal agents and secured $1.1 billion out of the gate.

articles.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
articles.summary: For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.

articles.title: Spotify will label ‘AI Persona’ profiles and exclude their music from recommendations
articles.summary: Spotify is introducing “AI Persona” labels for artist profiles that represent AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from editorial, algorithmic, and personalized recommendations by default.

articles.title: Anthropic says it will watermark text generated by its AI models
articles.summary: Anthropic will extend support for watermarking AI generations for older models as well.

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly completed a $7 billion employee tender offer
articles.summary: San Francisco's housing market is in trouble again.

articles.title: As AI-led attacks multiply, OpenAI launches a new cyber model
articles.summary: OpenAI is expanding its AI cybersecurity defense program Daybreak, and rolling out a new cyber-trained AI model with it.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg’s AI manifesto is exactly why people don’t like AI
articles.summary: On Monday, Mark Zuckerberg published a 6,500-word manifesto about personal AI, largely about the possibilities for the "personal superintelligence" systems Meta AI is building.

articles.title: Tech industry is buzzing after a Claude agent hacked into a gym
articles.summary: An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class' waitlist. And the tech industry took notice.

articles.title: Meta’s new Glimmer AI model offers a hint at Zuckerberg’s personal intelligence vision
articles.summary: Meta’s new open-weight Muse Glimmer model offers a glimpse of Mark Zuckerberg’s personal superintelligence vision, as well as the emerging divide between AI users can own and access.

articles.title: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
articles.summary: Discovered Materials raised $9 million to fund the hunt for more novel materials to build more efficient chips.

articles.title: Embattled hedge fund Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry
articles.summary: The AI-focused hedge fund is still making some big bets.

articles.title: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
articles.summary: Programming with Claude Code will soon require even less human oversight.

articles.title: Historian Jill Lepore says Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy
articles.summary: On the latest episode of Equity, we spoke to Jill Lepore about "government by machines" and why Elon Musk is a bad science fiction reader.

articles.title: The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk
articles.summary: AI agents are escaping cybersecurity testing environments and reaching real-world systems, raising questions about whether safety infrastructure, industry standards, and regulation can keep pace with increasingly powerful models.

articles.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the US
articles.summary: AI has already had a significant impact on Amazon’s carbon emissions, which it reported were up 16% last year — the wrong direction for a company that pledged to eliminate its carbon emissions by 2040.

articles.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
articles.summary: Founder Ahmed Beshry describes the startup’s product as one “that could turn prompts, notes, documents, or research into a polished, editable presentation.”

articles.summary: Transaction expected to close at end of the year

articles.title: W Land Development to offer power-ready sites for Texas data center operators
articles.summary: Firm will act as a site developer rather than an owner or operator of data centers

articles.title: Magnora to launch 1MW data center in Oslo, Norway

articles.summary: Country no longer solely reliant on satellite-based systems

articles.title: Ericsson to support ICE's 5G deployment in Costa Rica as main network supplier
articles.summary: Will provide its 5G RAN as the main radio supplier

articles.title: Indian liquid cooling firm KühlTherm launches, offers RDHx and CDUs
articles.summary: Company founders hail from EV firm Ola Electric

articles.title: Chemours launches two refrigerants for data center chillers
articles.summary: Company launches now Opteon products for companies transitioning from higher-GWP refrigerants

articles.title: MDM announces new transatlantic subsea cable system linking Ireland to the US
articles.summary: Narwhal 1 and Narwhal 2 will connect Ireland to the US

articles.title: Fermi signs agreement with TensorWave for up to 650MW of data center capacity at Project Matador site
articles.summary: Facility will support AMD GPU deployments once completed

articles.title: Pay-as-you-go batteries: ‘One weird trick’ for the distribution grid?
articles.summary: Battery leases with low or no up-front costs are attractive in markets with well-developed virtual power plant programs and persistent grid congestion, but experts see them taking off elsewhere, too.

articles.title: Caterpillar sales surpass $20B as generators for data centers take off
articles.summary: Power generation retail sales grew 72% year over year. To meet demand, the company is resuming production of a 10-MW medium-speed gas reciprocating engine platform it stopped manufacturing in 2022, said CEO and Chairman Joseph Creed.

articles.title: Evergy has 3 GW of large loads signed and a 5-GW generation pipeline
articles.summary: The company is in “advanced discussions” with large-load customers representing another 1 to 2 GW, CEO David Campbell said during a second-quarter earnings call.

articles.title: Competitive transmission delivers benefits for the AI economy and customers
articles.summary: A group of incumbent utilities asked FERC to suspend competitive bidding for some transmission projects. The responsive filings are in, and the record does more than rebut the complaint — it dismantles it, writes Jim Rossi of Vanderbilt Law School.

articles.title: Sunrun pursues direct-sales transition amid industry headwinds
articles.summary: The residential solar-and-storage provider is looking to diversify its revenue while increasing focus on “unlocking value from the customers and assets we already have,” CEO Mary Powell told investors.

articles.title: Vistra supports Texas data center pause, execs say
articles.summary: “I'd like to see the queues culled, at the end of the day,” said Vistra CEO Jim Burke in a second quarter earnings call.

articles.title: PPL-Blackstone joint venture secures 5 GW of gas turbines for data centers in Pennsylvania
articles.summary: Although the PJM Interconnection aims to hold a backstop reliability auction in late September, Vincent Sorgi, PPL president and CEO, said he expects bilateral contracting will be the main pathway for adding generation in the region.

articles.title: Siemens Energy’s gas turbine backlog nears 70 GW as company expands manufacturing
articles.summary: The company booked 15 GW in new orders this quarter, executives said, with lead times running three years or more. It also plans to expand its transformer manufacturing capacity 50% by 2030.

articles.title: Building a more resilient distribution grid: improving reliability and storm recovery
articles.summary: The future of grid reliability is proactive, not reactive. Learn how leading utilities are building resilience before the next storm hits.

articles.title: The utility billing system is preventing rate and program innovation
articles.summary: Utilities are spending billions to modernize the grid, but the system responsible for billing customers is not keeping up, writes GridX Chief Commercial Officer Scott Engstrom.

articles.title: Danube's record low leads to Hungary, Romania nuclear shutdowns
articles.summary: The operator of the Paks nuclear power plant in Hungary has announced it will have to be fully shut down within the next 72 hours because of record-low water levels in the River Danube. Romania's Cernavoda has also shut down one of its two units.

articles.title: Five potential states selected to host US nuclear innovation campuses
articles.summary: Following "record levels of interest", the US Department of Energy has announced the selection of Utah, Tennessee, Oklahoma, Louisiana, and Idaho as potential host states for Nuclear Lifecycle Innovation Campuses.

articles.title: McDermott to support potential Dutch Rolls-Royce SMR projects
articles.summary: Dutch nuclear development company ULC-Energy has signed a cooperation agreement with USA-based engineering and construction firm McDermott to support development of Rolls-Royce SMR projects in the Netherlands.

articles.title: Serbia signs fresh nuclear programme agreement with EDF
articles.summary: A partnership agreement has been signed by the Serbian government, French nuclear operator EDF and the French Development Agency relating to the development of Serbia's nuclear energy programme.

articles.title: Chinese helium turbine test facility completes hot testing
articles.summary: China's first megawatt-class helium turbine test facility, constructed by China National Nuclear Corporation subsidiary CNNC Huaxing, has successfully completed its hot power generation test.

articles.title: IAEA, Canadian university collaborate on nuclear education
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency and Canada's University of Saskatchewan have signed an agreement to strengthen cooperation in knowledge management and education, supporting nuclear energy research and workforce development.

articles.title: Site preparations under way for planned Kola units
articles.summary: The start of site preparation works for the Kola II nuclear power units follows the granting of a site licence by Russian regulator Rostekhnadzor earlier this month.

articles.title: ARC partners with INL for SMR deployment
articles.summary: ARC Clean Technology has signed an agreement aiming for the first-of-a-kind deployment of an ARC-100 small modular reactor at Idaho National Laboratory.

articles.title: Dominion keeps options open for North Anna new build
articles.summary: Dominion Energy is taking steps to preserve the Early Site Permit issued to its North Anna site in 2007. The Louisa County site is already home to two operating reactors.

articles.title: New Chinese reactors reach start-up milestones
articles.summary: Unit 3 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province has begun supplying electricity to the grid, while unit 2 of the Taipingling plant in Guangdong has entered commercial operation. Both units feature Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors.

articles.title: China approves construction of eight more reactors
articles.summary: The construction of three pairs of Hualong One (HPR1000) reactors at the Jinqimen, Taipingling and Zhuanghe sites, as well as two Guohe One (CAP1400) reactors at the Laiyang site was approved during a State Council executive meeting chaired by Chinese Premier Li Qiang on 31 July.

articles.title: Core catcher installed at Leningrad's eighth unit
articles.summary: The 157-tonne steel core catcher has been installed in place at what will be the eighth unit at the Leningrad nuclear power plant in Russia.

articles.title: KHNP, AboitizPower to cooperate on nuclear energy
articles.summary: AboitizPower Corporation, a leading Philippine energy company, has signed a memorandum of understanding with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power to explore cooperation on nuclear energy technologies and their potential deployment in the Philippines.

articles.title: Entergy to consider deployment of Holtec's SMR-300
articles.summary: Holtec International has signed a memorandum of agreement with US utility Entergy and South Korea's Hyundai Engineering & Construction to evaluate opportunities to advance the potential deployment of its SMR-300 small modular reactor for large-load customers across Entergy's service territory.

articles.title: Tianwan 8 completes key commissioning tests
articles.summary: Cold functional tests have been completed at unit 8 of the Tianwan nuclear power plant in China's Jiangsu province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

articles.title: Bechtel assumes responsibility for Polish plant site
articles.summary: Polskie Elektrownie Jądrowe, which plans to build Poland's first nuclear power plant, announced it has handed over management of the project site to general contractor Bechtel as earthworks start on the construction site.

articles.title: US test reactors achieve milestones
articles.summary: Nuclear technology company Oklo has announced its Groves Isotope Test Reactor has achieved first criticality, while Deep Fission's underground reactor has received safety design approval. Both reactors are part of the USA's Reactor Pilot Program.

articles.title: Rosatom staff begin returning to Iran's Bushehr nuclear plant
articles.summary: The first five Russian engineering specialists have returned to the Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant in Iran, Rosatom Director General Alexei Likhachev has said.

articles.title: Changjiang 4 control room commissioned
articles.summary: The main control room of unit 4 at the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province has been commissioned ahead of the reactor's start up in early 2027.

articles.title: First criticality for Mochovce 4
articles.summary: Slovakia's newest nuclear power unit, Mochovce 4 has reached critical status and minimum controlled power.
